decisions.reason: The illuminated candle arch line is close to the core seasonal offer and fits steady demand for Erzgebirge-style décor, though its absence from the website in 2020–2021 adds some risk.
A one-tier pyramid is a long-lived core product type for this workshop, so it is likely kept despite reduced visibility.
The motif platform depends on the electronic music box system that was withdrawn in 2019, so it has lost its purpose and should be discontinued.
The Dresden-themed pyramid builds on established craftsmanship and appeals to collectors and tourists, supporting continued sale.
